title: Brightness & Contrast
description: The basic tonal controls for a live source — brightness, contrast, exposure (in stops), gamma and saturation. The brightness/contrast/exposure/gamma curve is baked into a 256-entry lookup table each frame so it's a single table read per channel, then saturation is mixed per pixel around the luminance. Brightness is audio-mappable. Grades the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
